title: RX-S1/S2a/S2b: state-extract trio implemented
content: Three Rust refactor plan kinds are implemented and tested: `move_rust_struct_fields` (RX-S1, src/refactor/rust_move_fields.rs), `add_rust_delegate_field` (RX-S2a, src/refactor/rust_delegate_field.rs), and `update_rust_callers` (RX-S2b, src/refactor/rust_update_callers.rs). `rust_deep::is_copy_whitelist` is now `pub(crate)` for cross-module reuse. All three are unregistered with the PlanKind dispatcher (TODO stubs left); dispatcher wiring is a follow-up. Full suite passes (1285 tests).
rationale: RX-S1/S2a/S2b: state-extract trio + conservative caller rewrite consuming rust_deep Copy whitelist. S2b overlap detection guarantees non-overlapping FileEdit sets by treating entire call_expression byte ranges as outer rewrite units, pushing nested inner sites to overlapping_rewrite_sites. borrow_promotions are detected syntactically via &self receiver inspection (not type-level, which is a v1 limitation requiring post-apply cargo check).
